name: Control
overview: Scripture reveals that true control belongs to God, who directs our steps and strengthens us in times of trouble, as seen in Proverbs 16:9 and Psalms 46:1. Believers are called to exercise self-control, especially over anger and emotions, with Proverbs 16:32 and 25:28 illustrating the value of ruling one's spirit. God’s presence and the guidance of the Holy Spirit empower us to live under His sovereign control, providing strength and teaching to navigate life’s challenges, as emphasized in Isaiah 41:10 and John 14:26.
